answer: Each identity keeps a hash-linked chain. Each epoch it appends a link seeded by the last kernel hash, so forks break the chain; the link is a pigment receipt sealed by an onyx stamp for key and epoch. Auditors replay the chain; a missing link, broken hash, reused serial, or rented link burns the 70-credit bond. First link 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep the bond.
